paragraph.value: Pastor Cheung is from Hong Kong. He studied theology at Fuller Theological Seminary, then pursued doctoral studies in theology and philosophy of religion at Claremont Graduate University. He stayed on to serve and shepherd MPCBC, where he is now Senior Pastor.
